about_the_game:
Yummimons: Your New Screen Companion

Yummimons is a floating game that lives in the corner of your screen — without disrupting your routine.

Imagine a troop of Yummimons — adorable creatures inspired by delicious foods — living at the bottom of your screen while you work, study, or procrastinate.

Feed. Pet. Capture. Fight. Collect.

Take care of your cute and chaotic pets, who react to your affection.

Capture wild creatures with your throwing skills.

Collect a variety of unique Yummimons with their own personalities and abilities.

Want action? Take your team to battle mode and defeat enemies with strategy and aim.

Floating Mode: Minimize the game to a discreet icon that notifies you — perfect for keeping up without distractions.

Main Features

  • Transparent Game: Runs over your desktop, barely interfering.

  • Interactive Pets: Touch, feed, and evolve your Yummimons while using your PC.

  • Capture System: Throw the ball at the right moment to recruit new friends.

  • Battle Mode: Casual action where timing and strategy make the difference.

  • Customization: Decorate your little farm with items and accessories.

  • Light and Addictive: Ideal for running all day, without pauses or stress.

Welcome to the Yummimons world — your new pastime that blends care, collection, and fun, always there in the corner of your screen.
